subject: english
stem: A city note says bright bridge lights improve visibility. An astronomy group says upward light hides stars. What does the comparison show?
options: Both say the bridge has no lights.
The astronomy group discusses bridge strength.
The city wants to hide the bridge.
The city emphasizes visibility; the group emphasizes dark skies.

optionRationales.reason: Both say the bridge has no lights.：相反。
The astronomy group discusses bridge strength.：未提。
The city wants to hide the bridge.：相反。
The city emphasizes visibility; the group emphasizes dark skies.：兩來源對同 lighting 的不同影響。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「兩來源選擇的利益、風險與受影響群體顯示對同一事件的不同觀點」可推出 The city emphasizes visibility; the group emphasizes dark skies.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The city emphasizes visibility; the group emphasizes dark skies. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
